what: Cards are dealt one at a time — a card flies in at .75 from the bottom right (520,160) tilted 13° more and settles at its own tilt, and each time the earlier cards are pushed back by (−14,−16) · −2.6° to form a pile. Three papers come in from 260px to the right tilted 9° more at .18 intervals, and the photo drops from −120px above, spinning 75° at .7x, and stands at 9° (same type as an option)

options.from: Fly-in position “x,y,extra tilt,scale”, default “520,160,13,1” — paper “260,0,9,.96” · photo “0,-120,66,.7”
options.shift: Offset of the card in front as ”x,y,angle”, default ”-14,-16,-2.6” — ”none” means no offset
options.play: If ”enter”, plays once on entry. If not set, it is tied to scroll
options.data-tilt: (on cards) resting tilt (°), defaults −3·−2·−4·−2.5·−3.5·−2 in order

from.where: index.js chapter(features) feature card stack · chapter(why) three .paper sheets · [data-story-photo] photos
